last.verdict: Profit beat estimates, but a weaker trading outlook sent the stock down.

reasons.label: Trading slowdown warning
reasons.text: CFO said fourth-quarter Markets revenue could fall roughly 20% from a year earlier.

reasons.label: Investment banking dip
reasons.text: Investment banking revenue fell 13% from the prior quarter to $1.35 billion.

reasons.label: Credit cost worries
reasons.text: Provisions for credit losses were about $2.6 billion, adding to concern over earnings staying strong.

story: Citi has beaten profit estimates for two straight quarters, with profit up about 45% in Q2 and 40% in Q3. Even so, the stock fell after both: about 4% in July on higher spending plans, then about 5.6% now.
